campaign.name: Youth Camp | Parents
campaign.objective: Help parents of players aged 11 to 15 understand the experience and secure a place at the September youth camp.

concepts.name: They Just Love It
concepts.strategy: Enter through the observable fact that some kids just love basketball. Describe the behaviour so the parent recognises their own child. Reframe the job: give that enthusiasm a coached day where they can play, learn and come home wanting more.
concepts.audience: Parents and guardians of basketball players aged 11 to 15 in Birmingham and the West Midlands whose child is enthusiastic about the game.
concepts.proposition: Give their enthusiasm a full day of basketball, coaching and competition where they get better while enjoying the game.

ads.primary_text:
Some kids just love basketball.

They're playing it in the house, watching it, talking about it and asking when they can play again.

If that's your child, bring them down.

We'll give them a full day of basketball, great coaching, plenty of competition and a chance to get better while enjoying the game.

Sometimes you just need to give something they love the right place to grow.

Youth Camp. 27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.
ads.headline: They just love it.
ads.description: Give it the right place to grow

ads.primary_text:
You can normally tell when a child has really caught the basketball bug.

They're practising around the house. Watching clips. Trying new moves. Asking when training is.

We love seeing that.

Because at 11 to 15, they don't need somebody putting huge expectations on them.

They need somewhere they can play. Somewhere they can learn. Somewhere they can make mistakes, get coached and try again.

That's what we've built this camp around.

27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.

concepts.name: The Right Place To Grow
concepts.strategy: Enter through the parental worry about pressure and outcomes. Reframe the job at 11 to 15: not to figure out their future, but to give them a good environment. The camp provides good coaching, real competition and permission to make mistakes and improve.
concepts.audience: Parents who want structured basketball development for their child but feel pressure around expectations and outcomes.
concepts.proposition: A coached environment with experienced staff where effort and growth matter more than results and expectations are kept proportionate.

ads.primary_text:
At 11 to 15, they don't need somebody putting huge expectations on them.

They need somewhere they can play.

Somewhere they can learn.

Somewhere they can make mistakes, get coached, try again and slowly start figuring out what kind of player they are.

That's what we've built this camp around.

We'll work on their skills. We'll get them competing. We'll coach them properly.

But most importantly, we want them leaving wanting to play even more basketball than when they arrived.

Youth Camp. 27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.

ads.primary_text:
You don't have to figure out whether basketball is their future. That's not your job right now.

Your job is to give them a good environment. Coaches who know the game. Players who push them. A place where they can try things, make mistakes and get better.

The Youth Camp is that place.

27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.

concepts.name: Getting Better
concepts.strategy: Enter through the simple truth that young players get better by playing. Reframe the camp as a day of touches, repetitions, coaching and corrections in competitive situations.
concepts.audience: Parents of 11 to 15 year olds who want their child to develop skills, confidence and enjoyment through real coaching.
concepts.proposition: A full day of coached basketball with lots of ball-in-hands repetitions and competitive situations that help them improve.

ads.primary_text:
Kids get better at basketball by playing basketball.

Lots of touches. Lots of repetitions. Good coaching. Mistakes. Corrections. Then another go.

That's exactly what we're giving them.

A full day on court with us, learning, competing and enjoying the game.

Bring your player. We'll get to work.

Youth Camp. 27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.
ads.headline: Bring your player. We'll get to work.
ads.creative_alt: A young player shoots during a School of Skill youth camp session.

ads.primary_text:
Young players don't need 45 minutes standing in a line waiting for their turn.

They need the ball in their hands.

They need repetitions.

They need somebody watching closely enough to say 'try that again, but this time do this.' Then they need another go.

That's how we like to coach.

We'll spend the day working with players on their handle, movement, finishing, shooting and decision-making - then we'll put those skills into competitive situations where they actually have to use them.

Nobody needs to arrive as the best player in the gym.

Come ready to learn, compete and get better. We'll take care of the rest.

Youth Camp. 27 September 2026. Sandwell Academy, West Bromwich. Ages 11 to 15. £50 per player.
